Vrac 0.1.0 is the first public release of the local-first TUI outliner built
for capturing thoughts before they disappear.

> Capture first. Structure later—or never.

### What is already here

- A journal-first outliner with fast inline editing and Vim-inspired navigation.
- Stable `[[references]]`, indexed `#tags`, and contextual backlinks.
- Tasks, decisions, meetings, and ideas that remain attached to where they
  happened instead of requiring a second organization pass.
- Local SQLite state with portable checkpoints and synchronization material
  suitable for iCloud, Syncthing, Dropbox, or OneDrive.
- One binary that works as an interactive TUI, through SSH, and as a bounded
  scriptable CLI.
- Reproducible performance scenarios designed around several million nodes.
- An AGPLv3 codebase so distributed and network-facing derivatives remain free
  for their users.

### Install

macOS and x86_64 Linux users can use the verified installer:

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf \
  https://github.com/yan-imensar/vrac/releases/latest/download/vrac-installer.sh | sh
```

Prebuilt archives and SHA-256 checksums are also available below for Apple
Silicon and Intel macOS, x86_64 Linux, and x86_64 Windows.

Vrac is early software, but it is already used for daily notes. Your data
remains local, readable, and recoverable; the synchronized folder never holds
the live SQLite database.
